leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a recursive function to generate all subsets of a given array.
Initialize an empty array to store the result subsets.
Manipulate the current subset by pushing and popping elements during recursion.
Apply base case logic to add a copy of the current subset to the result.
Integrate the recursive calls to explore inclusion and exclusion of each element.
Render the final list of subsets for a sample input array.
Control the recursion depth to avoid infinite loops.
